resources.string: Pull one by one instead of using 10x pulls to stop immediately upon hitting the soft pity range.
Fully restart the game client and clear the cache to reset the local session seed before pulling.
Roll on a low-rarity, standard, or free daily banner first to dump \'bad rolls\' before switching to the rate-up banner.
Perform your pulls within the first 60 seconds of the daily server reset.
Pull immediately after a game update or maintenance finishes when servers come back online.
Pull during the final 10 minutes before a banner expires to catch last-second luck.
Track exact pull counts and stop precisely one pull before soft pity starts, then switch to single pulls.
Move your in-game main character to a high, scenic, or lore-relevant spot associated with the unit before pulling.
Put the character\'s best friend, rival, or ideal support unit into your main active party.
Play the character\'s official theme song or character trailer soundtrack on repeat while summoning.
Disconnect Wi-Fi, press the 10x pull button, let the network error pop up, reconnect, and load into the animation.
Cover your eyes or turn your phone screen down during the animation so the game doesn\'t detect what you want.
Tap the pull button using your nose or elbow instead of your fingers for a touch of unearned luck.
Have a friend who has famously good luck tap the summon button on your phone for you.
Draw or display a physical summoning circle under your phone screen before pressing the pull button.
Intentionally pull once on the weapon or equipment banner to pay tribute to the gacha system first.
Perform your multi-pulls while sitting on the toilet for peak casual gacha luck.
Pull at exactly 3:00 AM local time, the universal witching hour for rare drops.
Sell or upgrade low-rarity fodder items to free up inventory space and clear out negative energy.
Spend exactly 3 single tickets before committing any of your hard-earned premium gems.
Instantly skip the pull animation as fast as possible to catch the game engine off guard.
Tap through every single item manually without skipping to build maximum suspense.
Open the top-up shop screen to pretend you are about to buy microtransactions, then immediately go back to pull.
Equip your main character in their default starter skin to demonstrate humility before pulling.
Switch your in-game chat room to channel 7, 77, or 777 before tapping the summon button.
Play the targeted character\'s preview voice lines 5 times in a row right before opening the banner.
Quickly double-tap the multi-pull button to trick the UI into processing double rare rewards.
Send a high-risk message in guild chat right before pulling to lock in community pressure.
Turn your phone completely upside down until the entire sound effect finishes playing.
Spend every single pull down to exactly 0 currency to show absolute, unyielding dedication.
See more or less information about methods.
